name: RX-75 Guntank
description:
The RX-75 Guntank was the first prototype Earth Federation Forces mobile suit developed by Operation V. However, it was said to be closer to a tank rather than a mobile suit. A number of companies such as Takim and Hervic participated in its development. The Guntank had the torso and arms of a mobile suit, but possessed caterpillar treads for legs. Initially, it was designed to be piloted by a crew of two, with a gunner in the canopy-style cockpit on the head and a driver in another cockpit in the torso. However, it was later changed to be controlled by a single pilot in the canopy-style cockpit. Like all "Operation V" mobile suits, the Guntank used the Core Block System.
Its reactor is a hybrid type of nuclear reactors and gas turbines, and its output is insufficient for powering beam weapons. The Guntank's main weapons are twin 120mm cannons, which are effective at long and medium ranges. Its arms have four-barrel missile launchers instead of hands, and they provided good cover fire against enemy tanks and aircraft, but are less effective against enemy mobile suits. A major flaw of the Guntank is its inability to turn its torso, making it difficult to aim the cannons at moving targets, as the Guntank must reposition itself. Another major flaw is that its design was primarily for ground combat, resulting in it having poor maneuverability in space.

traits.name: Tz. 86 Colossus Stabilizer
traits.description: 1/round, the Guntank can reroll a cannon attack. The target cannot be in Hard Cover. You must keep the second result.

traits.name: Direct-Strike Ordnance
traits.description: The Guntank’s attacks ignore resistance to Kinetic and Explosive.

traits.name: Poor Maneuverability
traits.description: The Guntank must roll Agility Checks and Saves twice, keeping the lower result.

core_system.name: Stable Platform
core_system.active_effect:
Create a Blast 3 area within line of sight of yourself or an allied character and within Range of the “180mm Recoilless Cannons.” While the area is in place, you become Immobilized. You may, as a free action, shoot any characters that enter the area or start their turn inside the area with the “180mm Recoilless Cannons.” Characters partially within the affected area take half damage from these attacks.
This area lasts for the rest of the scene, or until deactivated as a protocol.
core_system.description: The Guntank's squat, wide form factor grants its operators a superb sense of stability under most conditions. Though the chassis is largely impossible to kit for different missions due to the lack of manipulators, its integrated weapons make strong use of this intrinsic stability, making long range shots and devastatingly accurate cover fire a simple matter.

traits.name: Solid Fuel Vernier Thrusters
traits.description: Gain +1 Accuracy on Agility checks.

traits.name: Integrated EVA Rig
traits.description: The RB-79 counts as having a propulsion system in low or zero gravity and submarine environments.

traits.name: Easy Maintenance
traits.description: While resting, the Ball can be repaired at a rate of 1 Repair per 1 structure damage, instead of 2 Repairs.

traits.name: Integrated Manipulators
traits.description: The Ball has the "Manipulators" system by default at no SP cost.

core_system.name: Atlas Gyrostabilizer
core_system.active_effect: For the remainder of the scene, the RB-79 ignores the Ordnance tag with Rifles and Cannons. Weapons without Ordnance instead gain Reliable based on weapon size (Auxiliary: 1, Main: 2, Heavy or larger: 3), or if they already have Reliable, add 1 to the default Reliable value.

name: MSM-03C Hygogg
description: Although the MSM-03 Gogg was one of the first true amphibious mobile suits, it was handicapped by several problems including being under-powered, limited armament, and poor performance on land. To address these shortcomings, the Hygogg was developed. Introduced at the end of the One Year War, this machine was designed from scratch and retained only its predecessor's basic concepts. The result was a smaller, lighter, compact, and more powerful machine equipped with an improved generator and better weaponry. Its agility and mobility in water and on land were also enhanced. Additionally, production costs were reduced due to the implementation of standardized parts, including the cockpit, derived from the United Maintenance Plan, which greatly enhanced repairs and servicing.

traits.name: Segmented Manipulator Mounts
traits.description: All melee attacks gain an additional range or threat, whichever is applicable.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.description: The Hygogg treats all bodies of water or similar fluids as normal terrain, and has integrated EVA for deep ocean environments.

traits.name: Meat Shield
traits.description: Whenever the Hygogg is grappling a character or lifting an object, all attacks made against it or adjacent allied characters gain +1 Difficulty. Additionally, any attacks that miss the Hygogg or an adjacent ally while this effect is active must be rerolled against a grappled character or lifted object of its choice. Pattern attacks are not affected by this trait.

core_system.name: Kraken Routine
core_system.active_effect: For the remainder of the scene, the Hygogg exerts a Burst 2 zone of control. Any character of its choice that enters, exits, or moves within this zone must succeed a Hull save or be pulled adjacent (or to the nearest free space) and grappled. Additionally, for the purposes of engagement, ramming, and grappling, the Hygogg always counts as the larger character while this effect is active.

name: VF-0 Phoenix
description: An experimental redesign of the venerable F-14 Tomcat, the VF-0 Phoenix is a new type of mobile suit that's capable of transforming between three different modes. Built to be highly adaptable to a chaotic battlefield, the Phoenix can use its transformation system to perform extreme high-G maneuvers in the air or as a means of staying mobile on the ground.

traits.name: Fragile
traits.description: The Phoenix receives +1 DIFFICULTY on HULL checks and saves.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The Phoenix gains +1 ACCURACY on AGILITY checks and saves.

traits.name: Head-Mounted Display Tracking
traits.description: Upon destroying or structuring a character after having consumed a Lock-On, the Phoenix may immediately apply Lock-On to any other character within Sensors (including the same character if this was triggered via structuring). This can only trigger once per character during the same turn.

traits.name: Highway to the...
traits.description: When in Danger Zone, 1/turn before or after any action, the Phoenix may move 2 spaces in any direction, ignoring engagement and reactions.

core_system.name: Variable Fighter Transformation System
core_system.active_effect:
As a Free Action, change into any other form. This action may be taken in the middle of any Full Action with two distinct parts (e.g. Barrage with two weapons). This action is Efficient, and refunds 1 Core Power at the end of any scene in which it’s used.
When this action is performed, gain the following benefit for each mode. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Battroid Mode

  • 1/round, when you hit a target with a Cannon weapon, you may apply the Lock-On and Shredded conditions. The Shredded condition lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

GERWALK Mode

  • 1/round, when consuming Lock-on, selecting another weapon with which to attack the same target instead deals full damage, heat, and burn on a hit.

Fighter Mode

  • 1/round, when consuming Lock-on as part of an attack made with a Launcher weapon, the resulting damage may not be reduced in any way.
core_system.description: The VF-0 Phoenix's unique high-speed transformation system allows for it to change mission roles on the fly, though it takes incredible resilience to high-G stresses to transform the Phoenix outside of recommended speed bands. Even then this is poorly advised due to the strain put on the airframe when performing an improper transformation, shortening the machine's service lifespan.
core_system.passive_effect:
As a Protocol, the Phoenix may change into one of the following modes. It may choose to start a scene in any form.

Battroid Mode

  • Gain +1 Difficulty when using Launcher weapons.
  • Gain +1 Accuracy when using Cannon weapons.
  • 1/round, when you hit a target with a Cannon weapon, you may apply the Lock-On condition.

GERWALK Mode

  • Treat all movement as if the Phoenix were Hovering.
  • 1/round, when consuming Lock-on, select another weapon with which to attack the same target, dealing half damage, heat, and burn on a hit.

Fighter Mode

  • Gain +1 Difficulty to all Melee attacks.
  • Treat all movement as if the Phoenix were Flying.
  • 1/round, the Phoenix may Boost as a Free Action.
  • 1/round, when consuming Lock-on as part of an attack made with a Launcher weapon, the attack gains AP.
  • 1/scene, as a Full Action, the Phoenix may ascend above the battlefield and then fly down to a free space anywhere on the map, completely bypassing engagement and reactions. Alternatively, you may exit combat with this action.

passive_actions.name: Change Mode
passive_actions.detail: The Phoenix may switch to a mode it is not already in.

name: MS-09 Dom
description:
A heavy mobile suit developed by Zimmad, the MS-09 Dom was a ground combat machine equipped with hovercraft technology. It was fitted with thermonuclear jets and rockets under its feet, allowing it to quickly move across the ground, greatly improving its mobility compared to previous ground-use mobile suits. Thanks to sensors located in front of its feet, it was able to traverse uneven terrain. While in cruising mode, it could hover across the ground using only its thermonuclear jets. The Dom can hover at a maximum speed of 381 km/hr for up to 5 hours.
Its primary thrusters adopted the Saturn Engine, a type of thermonuclear engine that used heavy elements such as zinc and lead as propellant, granting it higher thrust than thermonuclear engines that used lighter elements as propellant. The mobile suit's design was largely unchanged from the YMS-09 Prototype Dom aside from its appearance. It inherited the same cross-shaped monoeye rail from the MS-07C-5 Gouf Test Prototype, granting it an improved view of aerial targets. Lateral field of view was obtained by auxiliary sensors.
For defense, the Dom was heavily protected, adopting a unique "skirt armor" design to protect weak points in the back, such as thrusters. Its cockpit hatch armor, which was its greatest weakness in the front, was also greatly enhanced. However, since the cockpit was entered directly from the front of the Dom, pilots in desert and wetland areas complained that the console panel would become dirty from entering and exiting. Meanwhile, the Dom's head was merged into its chest, a design intended to deflect and ricochet enemy projectiles, as well as lowering the possibility of being hit.
The Dom's primary weapon, the 360mm Giant Bazooka, was developed in parallel with the mobile suit. It was capable of sinking a space cruiser with a single shot. It was also armed with a heat saber for close combat, as well as a scattering beam cannon in its chest, which was capable of blinding the enemy. It was said that the beam cannon was originally intended to be an energy port for beam weapons, but was repurposed after the development of beam weapons was delayed.

traits.name: Hover Thrusters
traits.description: The Dom ignores Difficult and Dangerous Terrain, as well as ground-based environmental effects. This trait is disabled until the end of your next turn if you take Structure or Stress damage. You are Slowed for the same duration.

traits.name: Juggernaut
traits.description: The Dom gains Resistance to all Damage, Heat, and Burn while moving.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.description: The Dom counts as Hard Cover for adjacent allies.

traits.name: Treacherous Cockpit
traits.description: The pilot (and any passengers) must succeed at an Engineering check to eject or dismount from the Dom.

core_system.name: Saturn Engines (Hover Type)
core_system.active_effect: Select two other allied characters within Range 5 and Line of Sight. All three of you may immediately Boost and Skirmish as a part of this action. Until this action resolves, both selected characters benefit from the effects of Juggernaut.
core_system.passive_effect: The Dom may split a Barrage action with its standard move so long as its Hover Thrusters are still active. Weapons with the Ordnance tag may be fired as the second part of the Barrage action even if the Dom moves this way.

name: YMS-15 Gyan
description:
The YMS-15 Gyan was developed by the Zimmad company in the late stages of the One Year War for the Principality of Zeon's second phase main mobile suit development project. It was designed with exceptional close combat ability in anticipation of melee combat against the Earth Federation's mobile suits. When needed, the Gyan can receive fire support from the MS-09B Doms or MS-09R Rick Doms. However, its focus on close combat resulted in lower versatility and this contributed to its loss to the Zeonic's MS-14 Gelgoog.
A powerful beam saber serves as Gyan's primary weapon, it also has a shield with 60 needle missiles and 25 hide bombs (space mines) for laying traps. The appearance of the Gyan, with its silver armor and Pickelhaube helmet design, has a strong resemblance to a medieval armored knight.

traits.name: Duelist's Stance
traits.description: 1/round, the Gyan may deal +1d6 bonus damage whenever it critically hits with a melee weapon.

traits.name: Perfect Form
traits.description: The Gyan considers all rolls 19+ as critical hits.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The Gyan gains +1 Accuracy on all Agility Checks and Saves

core_system.name: Fluid Pulse Accelerator
core_system.active_effect:
For the rest of the scene, gain the following benefits:
  • You may Overwatch with Melee Weapons whenever an enemy enters, exits, or moves within threat.
  • Whenever using Fancy Footwork, you may choose to move 2 spaces instead of 1 space.
  • Gain access to Parry and Riposte, a special Reaction that does not count toward the normal 1/turn Reaction limit.
core_system.description: A cylindrical unit located in the Gyan's groin, the fluid pulse accelerator stores excess pressure generated by the reactor, transmitting it to each actuator when needed. This greatly improves the responsiveness and torque of the Gyan's joints, allowing it to repeatedly move forward and backward, similar to fencing footwork. In the event of damage, it can be immediately ejected.

active_actions.name: Parry and Riposte
active_actions.detail: So long as the attacker is within threat, you may make an attack against them with any non-Superheavy Melee weapon. If this attack is a Critical Hit, they are additionally Jammed until the end of their next turn.
active_actions.trigger: You are targeted by a Melee attack and it misses.

core_system.passive_effect: 1/turn, before rolling a melee attack or before being targeted by a melee attack, the Gyan may move 1 space in a direction of its choice, ignoring engagement and reactions. If this movement moves either party out of threat, the triggering attack automatically misses.

name: MBR-04-Mk.VI Destroid Tomahawk
description:
Developed as a joint project between BAE Land Systems and General Resource's Chrysler Defense subsidiary, the Tomahawk is one of the first fielded of the "Destroid" line of mobile suits that takes some departures from established MS designs. Resembling the Guntank line of mobile weapons even more than the Guncannon, the Tomahawk carries more traditional weapon mountings on the end of its arms as opposed to the handlike manipulators of other mobile suits. The standard armament of these mountings are often similar to those found on main battle tanks, though certain configurations replaces them with other weapons such as rocket pods, Gatling cannons, and even energy weapons such as Megaparticle Cannons or Ionized Particle Projector Cannons. Combined with additional space for weapons on its shoulders and body, the Tomahawk lugs considerable firepower into the thick of combat.
In spite of its unusual configuration compared to most mobile suits, the Tomahawk actually shares roughly 70% parts commonality with the RGM-79 GM, making the machine rather easy to integrate into the arsenal of existing Federation arsenals. Spare parts for the remaining fraction is produced in significant enough numbers and designed intuitively to ensure that the Tomahawk has a smooth repair and maintenance process, to the point that certain GMs and Guncannons have seen Tomahawk parts being used for ad hoc repairs.
Along with the RGM-79GS Gunslinger GM, the Tomahawk is a popular mobile suit of choice for pilots of the Federation's Gunslinger Initiative, a special training program to produce pilots that can fight on par or even exceed the skills of Zeon's own top aces and survive to pass their experience down to other pilots. As opposed to the Gunslinger GM, the Tomahawk emphasizes accurate barrages of lethal firepower to suppress dangerous threats before they can close into close combat, though unconventional modifications of the Tomahawk have seen it holding up fairly well in close combat in the right hands.

traits.name: Replaceable Parts
traits.description: While resting, the Tomahawk can be repaired at a rate of 1 REPAIR per 1 structure damage, instead of 2 REPAIRS.

traits.name: Slow
traits.description: The Tomahawk receives +1 DIFFICULTY on Agility checks and saves.

core_system.name: Equalizer Fire Control System
core_system.active_effect: For the rest of the Scene, Barraging can be done with all weapon mounts in exchange for 1d3+1 Heat.
core_system.description: Built for the Tomahawk's main role as a frontline fire support mobile suit, the Equalizer Fire Control System assists in adjusting the optimal convergence zone of its weaponry in order to maximize overall accuracy. In addition, an "Alpha Strike" Protocol can be activated which primes all of the Tomahawk's weapons for either attacking many targets or concentrating on a singular target. While the resulting heat buildup for initiating an Alpha Strike can risk damage to the mobile suit's internals, it is often deemed an acceptable tradeoff when in situations where such an immediate output of firepower is necessary.
core_system.passive_effect: When Barraging, all attacks receive +1 ACCURACY.

name: RX-79BD-1 Blue Destiny
description:
The Blue Destiny Unit 1 was a modified RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type, with improved generator output and enhanced mobility thanks to the use of magnet coating and added leg verniers. Weapons-wise, it had additional armament in the form of a pair of 60mm chest vulcans and a pair of wire-guided missile launchers on the stomach.[1] It was also equipped with the same 100mm machine gun, beam sabers, and shield as the Gundam Ground Type.
The development of the Blue Destiny Unit 1 was led by Dr. Chlust Moses, a researcher from the Principality of Zeon's Flanagan Institute who defected to the Earth Federation, and incorporated the EXAM System, a unique mobile suit operating system that he invented.[1] Originally, the Blue Destiny Unit 1 was based on the RGM-79[G] GM Ground Type. However, as its performance did not meet the demands of the EXAM System, the GM Ground Type's head, which was already installed with the EXAM System, was removed and mounted on a modified chassis based on the Gundam Ground Type.
The EXAM System was designed to draw out a mobile suit's full potential for a limited time. However, it was highly unstable, and prone to going berserk, attacking friends and foes alike. Federation mechanic Alph Kamra later installed a limiter on the Unit 1, limiting the EXAM System's output at 50% to prevent it from going berserk. The output can be raised to 100% when necessary, but this can only be sustained for 5 minutes before the machine overheats.

traits.name: Killer Instinct
traits.description: The Blue Destiny gains +1 Accuracy to Ranged attacks while in Danger Zone.

traits.name: Electromagnetic Servos
traits.description: The Blue Destiny has +1 Accuracy to Agility checks.

traits.name: Unstable
traits.description: The Blue Destiny suffers +1 Difficulty to Systems Checks. In addition, upon failing any Systems check initiated by a hostile character, the Blue Destiny makes an automatic Skirmish attack with the last Mount used, on the closest valid target, friend or foe. If no Mount has been used in the scene, the mount with the highest theoretical maximum damage is used.

core_system.name: EXAM System
core_system.active_effect:
All of the Blue Destiny's weapons gain Reliable X for the rest of the scene, where X is equal to one third of the weapon's theoretical maximum damage.
While Full Power EXAM System is engaged, the Blue Destiny MUST make an attack, ram, or grapple action on at least one valid target once per round. If this does not occur, the Blue Destiny will make an automatic Skirmish on the closest valid target with the weapon mount which has the highest theoretical maximum damage. If all targets are out of range, the Blue Destiny will take an automatic move action in the direction of the closest valid target. If the Blue Destiny cannot move freely when this occurs for any reason, it will take 1d6 AP kinetic damage.
core_system.description: As awareness (and hatred) of Newtypes grows, a number of machines and systems are being engineered to counter their abilities. EXAM is one of these, designed as a system that gives normal pilots the ability to mimic the power of Newtypes. While little is known about the mechanics of the system, the primary component [REDACTED]. The conflict of [REDACTED] with the bonds of the system makes it extremely unstable and hard to control, to the point that the system - and the mobile suit - will sometimes go berserk. Eventually, a limiter was set in the EXAM system by Alph Kamra, restricting it to roughly half of its output and only allowing the full output to be used for 5 minutes before the machine overheats. While under the influence of the EXAM System, the mobile suit's optical sensors glow red.

name: Metal Gear RAY
description:
Designed as an amphibious weapon to meet the standards of the U.S. Marine Corps, Metal Gear RAY was a versatile weapon both on the ground and underwater. Standing over twenty meters tall, the original prototype RAY required a pilot to operate it, after having first undergone VR training. The cockpit controls also acted as a harness of sorts, pressuring the pilot into the seat, to avoid being thrown around. The giant "wings" located on each side of the unit acted as a propulsion device. A tail on the hind end of the unit helped to steer the unit underwater.
RAY's initial and most prominent armament was a water cutter housed in the mouth, although its power far exceeds that of a normal water cutter. Powered by a massive pump, water would be sucked into an internal tank and then expelled as a narrow stream under extremely high pressure. As RAY's primary weapon, its purpose was to sever and slice almost anything that stood in its way, even dense armor.
Other armaments include gatling gun pods located at the end of each "wing," a missile pod located on its back capable of firing homing missiles and cluster bombs, and knee-mounted missile pods for ground defense. Metal Gear RAY's exterior metallic casing and armor is made of a ceramic-titanium alloy for defense against light to medium projectile assault.
Metal Gear RAY had a more organic design than previous models, both in appearance and in function. Its streamlined shape helped to deflect enemy fire and allowed for greater maneuverability both on land and in water. Its interior workings were also somewhat organic, as it had artificial fibers that contracted when electricity was applied, much like natural muscle, instead of typical hydraulics; this pseudo-muscle tissue made it very maneuverable for its time. It also had a nervous-system-like network of conductive nanotubes, which connected the widely dispersed sensor systems and relay commands from the cockpit to the various parts of RAY's body, automatically bypassing damaged systems and rerouting to auxiliary systems when needed. Another feature was its blood-like armor-repair nanopaste, which was secreted from valves and coagulates wherever the exterior surface is damaged.
Unlike prior Metal Gears (Metal Gear EXCELSUS notwithstanding), it lacked any nuclear weapons and did not function as a nuclear weapons platform. However, it still counted as a Metal Gear as, while lacking any nuclear armaments or nuclear launch capabilities in itself, it nonetheless was developed specifically to counter the various Metal Gear REX derivatives (which were developed with nuclear armaments), and thus still applied under the overall framework of nuclear strategy.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description:
RAY benefits from a unique echolocation subsystem, tightly integrated with the onboard targeting computer.
  • RAY may ignore the HIDDEN and INVISIBLE status when using the Lock-On quick tech action.
  • When RAY utilizes the Lock-On quick tech action, all hostile MECH type characters within a blast one radius of the initial target also gain the LOCK-ON status.
  • Additionally, Lock-On quick tech actions originating from the RAY inflict the special "Pinged" condition, which forces any INVISIBLE or HIDDEN target to make a systems check at the beginning of their turn, until the LOCK ON condition is removed. Upon failure, the target loses the HIDDEN or INVISIBLE condition.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: RAY counts has having full range of motion in aquatic environments, including flight. It is also immune to AQUATIC difficult and dangerous terrain.

traits.name: Relentless Predator
traits.description:
When attacking any hostile character with the Pinged condition, the RAY may inflict 2 heat upon itself to benefit from one of two abilities (but not both in the same action):
  • The RAY may force an INVISIBLE target to reroll their INVISIBLE "coinflip" roll. This may occur any number of times until RAY Overheats.
  • Apply an additional Accuracy stack to the attack, to a maximum of 6 Accuracy.

traits.name: Mothball
traits.description: The RAY's dated design makes it unwieldy, and difficult to use in the modern age battlefield. Thus, it takes Inaccuracy on all HASE checks, and must take the lowest of two rolls on all Structure checks.

core_system.name: UHPH-10 "POSEIDON" HYDROCANNON
core_system.active_effect: For the remainder of the scene, when the RAY uses the Lock-On quick tech action, all hostile MECH type characters with range 3 of the initial target gain the LOCK ON status. Additionally, gain access to the "Thunderous Shriek" action.

active_actions.name: Thunderous Shriek
active_actions.detail: As a full action, the RAY will bellow an omnidirectional shriek of dangerous high-intensity noise, marking all hostile MECH characters within sensors with LOCK ON and PINGED, in addition to all hostile MECH characters within range 3 of successfully LOCKED ON characters. All characters within Sensors with the SQUAD or SOLDIER tags, friendly or hostile, take 2d6 AP Kinetic damage. The RAY itself also gains the LOCK ON status, which cannot be removed by any means until the beginning of its next turn.

core_system.passive_effect: During any Full Repair, the pilot may switch the Poseidon Hydrocannon to a Plasma Cutter. In this state, the Hydrocannon does not charge in water sources, deals Energy instead of Kinetic damage, gains the Overkill tag, and gains BURN X, where X equals the number of charges available. In lieu of passive charging, the pilot gains access to the Plasma Charge action.

passive_actions.name: Plasma Charge
passive_actions.detail: Inflict 2 heat to the RAY. Gain +1 charge to the Poseidon Hydrocannon.

name: RGM-79 GM
description:
The RGM-79 GM is a mass-produced mobile suit based on the RX-78-2 Gundam. Its basic frame is easily adaptable to modifications into mission specific GM models, and has a fairly high level of mobility, for the time, both on Earth and in space. It has a maximum acceleration of 0.94 Gs in space, which is better than the Gundam's and roughly twice of the Zaku's. On Earth's surface, the GM is also faster than the Zaku II. The armor of the GM is made of Titanium Alloy, a sturdy metal that could be refined more quickly and easily than the Gundam's Luna Titanium Alloy. Although titanium alloy is less durable than luna titanium, it is also slightly lighter, which reduces the GM's overall mass compared to the Gundam's, and is still superior to the Zaku II's super-high tensile steel armor.
The GM was primarily armed with a beam spray gun, a less powerful version of the Gundam's beam rifle. Early in production, the beam spray gun had yet to be mass-produced, so most GMs were equipped with various machine guns. These machine guns continued to be used by the GMs later, and the machine could also use the Gundam's beam rifle when required. It could also use a mass production version of the Gundam's Hyper Bazooka for heavier firepower. For close combat, the GM is typically equipped with a beam saber, and a shield similar to the one used by the Gundam. Commander units sometimes featured a second beam saber. Lastly, the GM has a pair of head-mounted 60mm vulcan guns for intercepting missiles, small vehicles or to stop enemy MS from closing in.

traits.name: Assembly Line Manufacture
traits.description: You may repair all destroyed Weapon Mounts OR Systems at the cost of 1 Repair, rather than 1 Repair apiece.

traits.name: Redundant Systems
traits.description: Once per mission, the RGM-79 may stabilize as a quick action.

core_system.name: Standardized Weapon Racks
core_system.active_effect: Once per mission, the RGM-79 may discard its current weapon armaments and exchange them for a new set. The old weapons are lost and cannot be re-equipped.
core_system.passive_effect:
Upon creation or during a Full Repair, select one weapon type. All Main weapons of that type gain one of the following effects depending on weapon type:
  • Melee: 1/round on critical hit, damage from the attack gains AP. If the attack already has AP, or otherwise cannot be reduced, you may take 1 heat to add +2 bonus damage.
  • Rifle: Gain Reliable 1, and any weapon with Reliable increases its effect by 1.
  • Cannon: Gain Knockback 1, and any weapon with Knockback increases its effect by 1. 1/round on critical hit, the target must pass a Hull save or be knocked Prone.
  • Launcher: Weapons with Ordnance loses the tag. Weapons without Ordnance gains Arcing. Weapons with Arcing may 1/round attack as if they were Seeking.
  • CQB: This weapon ignores penalties from Engagement.
  • Nexus: 1/round, when consuming Lock On with this weapon it gains AP and Overkill.
If the GM should ever mount an Aux weapon to its Main mount, or an Aux or Main weapon to its Heavy mount, that weapon mount will benefit from +1 accuracy and +1 additional damage.

traits.name: Mass Production
traits.description: While resting, the Zaku can repair Stress and Structure at a rate of 1 Repair per 1 Stress, instead of 2 Repairs.

traits.name: Defiance
traits.description: Upon losing Structure, the Zaku gains Resistance to all damage types for the rest of the round.

core_system.name: "Paradise Lost" Fusion Reactor Redundancy Suite
core_system.active_effect: Until the end of your next turn, the Zaku gains resistance to all damage. For the remainder of the scene, the Zaku takes the highest roll on all structure and stress checks, rather than the lowest.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The Z'gok ignores all Aquatic difficult and dangerous terrain.

traits.name: Phantom Reach
traits.description: All of the Z'gok's MELEE weapons gain +2 Threat while Hidden.

traits.name: Cold Blooded
traits.description: 1/round, the Z'gok may cool 2 Heat while HIDDEN, as a free action.

core_system.name: Leviathan Engine
core_system.active_effect: Immediately become INVISIBLE and HIDDEN until the end of your next turn. Upon destroying any target, the Z'gok may elect to become INTANGIBLE as a free action. At the start of the Z'gok's next turn, they must to teleport anywhere within Movement as a free action, and may clear 2 heat in addition to one condition of their choice, at which point they are no longer INTANGIBLE, becoming INVISIBLE and HIDDEN instead.

name: RGM-79GS Gunslinger GM
description:
Iterated from Rolls Royce's RGM-79AWM Arctic Warfare GM, the GS GM, also known as the 'Gunslinger' GM, is an improved RGM-79 GM designed by General Motors for high-intensity warfare in dense urban environments. The Gunslinger GM was one of the first in the GM family to make use of vernier thrusters distributed all over its body even for ground configurations. In addition, its backpack was redesigned from scratch into two separate types for optimized operation in space or atmosphere. It is also one of a few GM models that uniformly makes use of the monoeye configuration for its main head camera, granting it enhanced precision in ranged attacks. Additional sensors in both its main head unit and its backpack (replacing the usual beam saber mounting that other GMs possess) grants it a higher degree of battlefield awareness.
Due to its popularity as a squad lead unit, the Gunslinger GM has also gained a second unofficial moniker as the Command GM.

traits.name: Gunslinger's Grit
traits.description: 2/round upon successfully evading an attack, the Gunslinger GM can immediately move 1 space in any direction as long as it isn’t Immobilize or Slowed. This movement ignores engagement and doesn’t provoke reactions.

traits.name: Quick Draw
traits.description: 1/round, whenever the GM Gunslinger is targeted by an attack, it may Skirmish before being attacked against the attacker, expending its Overwatch reaction. However all damage dealt is halved. If the attacker is destroyed or structured from this attack, the GM Gunslinger may move up to its speed, ignoring Engagement and Reactions.

traits.name: Integrated Command Module
traits.description: 1/round, as a reaction, you may allow an allied character to reroll an attack, check, or save.

core_system.name: All-Terrain Aggressive Maneuver System
core_system.active_effect: Until the end of the scene, Gunslinger's Grit now moves up to 3 spaces and ignores Immobilized and Slowed. This combat maneuver may be treated as Flying, but must end the movement on the ground or another solid surface, or else immediately begin falling. In addition, Quick Draw now deals full damage, heat, and burn.
core_system.description: The ATAMS is a combination of additional verniers distributed through its body and durable rapid-response sensors located in its head unit and backpack. Using this system, the Gunslinger GM in the right hands is incredibly hard to pin down. Normally the performance of this system is suppressed in order to prevent collateral damage from accidental collisions, but the safety measures can be shut off whether due to extenuous circumstances or if such danger is not a factor.

name: MS-18E Kämpfer
description:
A variant of a late-war mobile suit design, the MS-18E Kämpfer is a very singularly focused design that prioritized speed and firepower over armor protection. The E model was originally built as a high-speed assault unit assigned to special forces, eschewing its base model's armor to make room for additional weapon mounts (of which were jettisonable in order to minimize dead weight during prolonged combat).
First spotted during Operation Odessa, the Kämpfer gained a reputation for being an especially dangerous city-fighter, ambushing Federation units in tight close-quarters engagements to deadly effect.
Ironically, one of the most famous specimens was a Kämpfer that had been captured by Ukrainian militia during the Battle of Odessa City, the blue-and-gold emblazoned machine used by the Ukrainian citizens in spearheading the charge to retake the city.
With the end of the war, production on the Kämpfer has winded down significantly, though the Republic of Zeon maintains a small fleet of these machines. It has also seen rising popularity with private defense contractors, due to its specs lending itself well in short-duration search and destroy operations against militant insurgencies.

traits.name: Expendable Mountings
traits.description: 1/round, the Kämpfer may perform the following action:

actions.name: Discard
actions.detail: As a Free Action, the Kampfer may expend a Charge from any Limited system in exchange for 1 Momentum.

traits.name: Einhauen
traits.description: 1/turn, when the Kämpfer uses a weapon or system with the Limited tag, it may move up to 3 spaces, before or after taking the action, ignoring engagement and reactions. This includes using the Discard action.

traits.name: Fragile
traits.description: The Kämpfer takes +1 difficulty on all Hull checks and saves.

core_system.name: Wilde Jagd Combat Computer
core_system.active_effect: For the rest of the Scene, raise the maximum amount of Momentum dice you can hold to 6. Remove the round restriction on taking Momentum actions and generating Momentum dice. Additionally, gain access to the following options:

active_actions.name: Push
active_actions.detail: (Cost: 3 dice) Move in a straight line up to your speed, ignoring engagement and obstructions. Select up to 3 characters in or adjacent to this path—they each take 1d6 AP Kinetic damage and must pass an Agility save or else fall Prone. Objects in this path take 10 AP Kinetic damage.

active_actions.name: Brutalize
active_actions.detail: (Cost: 3 dice) Choose any non-Superheavy weapon. The next time you attack with this weapon, destroying a target or dealing structure damage triggers the following secondary attack effect: move up to your speed and attack any other character within range. Secondary attacks may trigger additional secondary attacks.

active_actions.name: Phase
active_actions.detail: (Cost: 2 dice) Roll a number of dice equal to this ability’s cost. A number of attacks made against you (equal to your lowest rolled value) treats you as if you were Invisible. Attacks affected by this ability are unable to inflict any non-damage effects, such as Reliable. This effect lasts until either all charges have been used, or the end of your next turn.

core_system.passive_effect:
Upon inflicting structure damage on an enemy (including destroying), gain a D6 Momentum dice, up to a maximum of 3. This can only be generated once per enemy per round, even if multiple structure damage was inflicted.
1/round, you may spend your Momentum for one of the following effects as a Free Action.

passive_actions.name: Recover
passive_actions.detail: (Cost: 1 die) Make an Agility Check, using the die as Accuracy. Clear the Slowed or Immobilized condition on a successful check. This ability can only clear one condition per die.

passive_actions.name: Scrape
passive_actions.detail: (Cost: 1 die) Pick a target within Range 3. You fire your head-mounted Vulcans, dealing 2 Kinetic damage. If you cause structure damage or kill a hostile mech character with this action, refund the cost.

passive_actions.name: Dodge
passive_actions.detail: (Cost: 2 dice) Roll the dice and pick the highest of the two. Gain Overshield equal to the result, dissipating at the end of your next turn. When this Overshield is expended, you may move up to your speed, ignoring engagement and reactions.

name: MSM-03HA Hygogg "Hunter"
description:
A postwar Zeon Republican modification of the Hygogg, the Hunter variant of the Hygogg is analogous to Federation Full Armor refits from the One Year War. This moniker was given due to being designed for frontline 'Hunter-Killer' tactics, where typically it'd be deployed as part of a pair, often partnered with either the base Hygogg or another Hunter Hygogg. The Hunter Hygogg would be used to draw incoming fire and identify the attacker while the other would eliminate said attacker.
While still largely untested in a full-scaled war, the Hunter Hygogg has seen limited deployment during Federation peacekeeping operations in Southeast Asia.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.description: The Hygogg treats all bodies of water or similar fluids as normal terrain, and has integrated EVA for deep ocean environments.

traits.name: Uparmored Bulk
traits.description: Any hostile action that must draw line of sight through the Hunter Hygogg to reach its target must be redirected toward the Hunter Hygogg. Cone and Line effects that intersect with Hunter Hygogg may not pass through it.

traits.name: Mobile Defender
traits.description: Gain access to the Hustle Reaction

actions.name: Hustle
actions.detail: Move up to your speed along the shortest possible route to intersect the action.
actions.trigger: An ally within Sensors is targeted by any hostile effect.

core_system.name: MAV Tactical Algorithms
core_system.active_effect:
Select an allied character within Sensors to designate as a Battle Buddy. A data-link opens between your machines, increasing your efficiency when working together. This connection remains active until the end of the Scene. Both parties gain unique effects, which are active so long as they are adjacent with one another.
  • Hunter Hygogg effect:
    • Gain resistance to all Damage, Burn, and Heat that isn’t self-inflicted.
  • Battle Buddy effect:
    • Gain the Counterattack reaction.

active_actions.name: Counterattack
active_actions.detail: Skirmish against the triggering hostile character if they are in range, dealing half damage, burn, and heat on a hit. This attack has a base +1 Accuracy.
active_actions.trigger: The Hunter Hygogg is targeted by any hostile effect.

name: MS-06X Psycommu Zaku
description: The Psycommu Zaku is an experimental Federation weapon currently in limited production. This design is based on highly classified Zeonic design documents that were a part of the "Bishop Plan," a research initiative dedicated to developing remote-control weapons controlled by Newtype brainwaves. Though it was never realized during the One Year War due to resource constraints and lack of confidence in its highly experimental design, Anaheim collaborated in its development during a post-war boom in interest for remote Newtype weaponry. In essence, it’s a stripped down Zaku II with highly sensitive psycommu control systems built into the frame. It has a limited capacity to control wireless, guided, miniaturized weapon platforms called funnels. Due to the sensitive nature of the highly experimental psycommu control system, this mobile suit is reserved for Newtype and Cyber Newtype pilots, often members of the Federation’s paramilitary special forces, Task Force Ouranos. Though, special exceptions are often made for members of the regular EFSF forces, so long as they have the prerequisite aptitude.

traits.name: Hive Guard
traits.description: Gain access to the Hive Guard Reaction.

actions.name: Hive Guard
actions.detail: Select an allied Drone within Sensors Range. As long as there is a path to reach you, the Drone is moved adjacent to the target and is hit instead.
actions.trigger: You or an adjacent ally have been targeted by an enemy attack.

traits.name: Sixth Sense
traits.description: The Psycommu Zaku may draw Sensors and Line of Sight from any of its deployed drones for the purpose of Tech Actions.

core_system.name: Psycommu System
core_system.active_effect: Recall all weapons with the Drone tag. You may then redeploy as many of them as you wish—after which you may attack once with all deployed weapons.
core_system.description: An experimental interface built into the Mobile Suit. It runs to the pilot, reading brain waves and converting thought into machine code. The results speak for themselves; actions are executed at a speed as quick as thought, allowing dozens of individual weapon platforms to deploy and fire on target.

name: SRf-06 Dahle
description:
Dahle or Desert Skink is a designation used for a somewhat broad category of 'Franken Suits', Mobile Suits cobbled together from a wide range of salvaged parts, typically that of Zakus and GMs. Commonly used by insurgent and revolutionary groups that acquired said parts through black market deals, configurations tend to vary wildly as much due to resource constraints as much as tactical needs. This is made possible in part due to GM parts being developed with the feature to be refitted to captured Zakus and vice-versa as a contigency plan for potential resource shortages should the Principality of Zeon force Earth's militaries into fighting a guerilla war. Such features are perhaps ironically now often used to facilitate the arming of guerilla forces that stand in opposition to the current status quo on Earth.
There also exists a rough template used by certain national and private entities as an 'economy' option over buying whole mobile suits. This version is analogous to the Earth Federation's Zanny mobile suit, a Zaku II refitted with technologies that would be later used on the GM.
Notable operators of this pattern group include the Kurdish Free State, the South Seas Alliance, and the Afghan National Resistance Front.

traits.name: Of the Land
traits.description: While resting, the Dahle can replenish Drones or Deployables with the Limited tag, at a rate of 1 repair per charge, up to your current maximum. At your discretion, you may also do this for allies, using your own repairs.

traits.name: Sacrifice
traits.description: 1/round, as a Free Action, destroy one of your drones or deployables within Sensors and line of sight. Your next attack deals +1d6 bonus damage.

traits.name: Old Bones
traits.description: You take +1 Difficulty to all System Checks and Saves.

core_system.name: Quick-Eject Mounts
core_system.active_effect: Gain access to the Autotomy Reaction.

active_actions.name: Autotomy
active_actions.detail: Be reduced to 1 health instead. A mount or system of your choice is removed from your mech and placed on any free adjacent space as a size 1 obstruction with 10 HP. This mount or system may not be retrieved until the end of the scene, if it was not destroyed. For purposes of talents and traits, this is considered a Deployable. You may then move up to your speed in a direction of your choice, ignoring engagement and reactions. If you end this movement in a space where you may hide, you become Hidden.
active_actions.trigger: You are about to take a structure damage, or your machine is about to be destroyed.

name: RGM-79SP GM Sniper II
description: Developed from the well liked RGM-79SC GM Sniper Custom and based on the GM Gunslinger, the RGM-79SP Sniper II is the premiere Federation sniper mobile suit. The last of the GM-Type units and most advanced of the GM Sniper line, the Sniper II was unfortunate in its production, being developed late into the One Year War. Regardless of its late arrival, the machine proved itself to be a powerful machine, even rivaling the legendary Gundam itself. A master of long-range shooting, the Sniper II was used to take out priority targets throughout the course of the war. Even then, the Sniper II was also competently capable of engaging enemies within close to medium ranges. Only a few GM Sniper IIs were manufactured due to their late war development, yet the frame remains in active service long after the OYW thanks to its excellent performance and shooting capabilities.

traits.name: Hybrid Sights
traits.description: 1/round, gain +1 Accuracy when attacking with a ranged weapon at range 10 or further, and gain +1d6 bonus damage when attacking with a ranged weapon at range 10 or less.

traits.name: Step Off
traits.description: 1/round when striking with a melee attack, the attack gains 2 additional knockback. Afterwards, move up to speed in any direction.

core_system.name: Hermes Type 1 Targetting Visor
core_system.active_effect:
When you critically hit a hostile character with a Ranged Attack, you may as a Free Action expend a Core Power to inflict one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of the enemy’s turn:
Disarm: Select a weapon or system of the target and destroy it. They may no longer use the destroyed weapon or system. They must make an Engineering Save at +1 Difficulty or remain unable to use the weapon or system until their next turn.
Cockpit Snipe: Target must make a Hull save at +1 Difficulty. On failure, target becomes Stunned until the end of their next turn. On success, target instead becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.
Sever Comms: Your target becomes Jammed or Impaired. Flip a coin to decide the effect. They must make a Systems Save at +1 Difficulty or remain Jammed or Impaired until their next turn. 
This ability is Efficient and will refund 1 Core Point at the end of any scene in which this ability was used.
core_system.description: Mounted on the head unit of the GM Sniper II is a specialized head visor created for precision shooting. It is fitted with built-in compound sensors, laser rangefinders, powerful cameras, and image stabilizers that give the pilot unparalleled picture quality. Alongside the sensors and coolers within the head unit itself, pilots could accurately hit targets no matter how far they were.

name: X-1 Methuss
description: After the completion of the MSA-005 Methuss, Anaheim Electronics started to explore further development potential of the mobile suit. The design team for the MSA-005X-1 Methuss X-1 included former members of the Hervic Company, which developed the FF-X7 Core Fighter during the One Year War. The X-1 was designed for air superiority in a 1G environment, resulting in its mobile armor mode resembling an air combat fighter. Stealth properties built into the design of the X-1 made it difficult to detect by radar. The X-1’s clipped delta wing design allowed for stable, high-speed flight. Its tail stabilizers, which mounted electronic equipment, were later used by the Zeta Plus series and other mobile suits.

traits.name: Fragile
traits.description: The X-1 makes all Hull Checks and Saves with +1 Difficulty.

traits.name: Calibrated Weapon
traits.description: When you build this mech or Rest, choose 1 Ranged Weapon. 1/turn, you ignore the Heat (self) and Ordnance tag of that weapon.

traits.name: Reactor Bleed
traits.description: When the X-1 is in the Danger Zone, all of its weapons that would deal kinetic or explosive damage instead deal energy. Additionally, 1/turn when you consume Lock On for an attack roll while in the Danger Zone, the attack’s damage, heat, and burn cannot be reduced.

core_system.name: AIR SUPERIORITY KIT
core_system.active_effect:
Trigger: When a hostile character moves within Range 10 and Line of Sight, even if that movement does not provoke Reactions.
Effect: You may expend your Overwatch reaction to Barrage against the triggering character. This Barrage ignores restrictions against allowing Superheavy weapons to fire as a reaction and counts as having consumed Lock On. This action is Efficient, and refunds 1 Core Power at the end of any scene in which it’s used.
core_system.description: The X-1's design team conducted trials at the California Base, including transformation tests at subsonic speeds to observe the X-1’s adaptability in changing combat situations. However, the X-1 was unable to withstand the shock of transformation at subsonic speed and was destroyed. However, the data gathered contributed to improving the atmospheric flight performance of the MSZ-006A1 Zeta Plus A1.

active_actions.name: Hyper-Active Intercept
active_actions.detail: You may expend your Overwatch reaction to Barrage against them. This ignores restrictions against allowing Superheavy weapons to fire as a reaction, but if you don’t fire a Superheavy with this action, you may instead Barrage with up to 3 Mounts. This action is Efficient, and refunds 1 Core Power at the end of any scene in which it’s used.
active_actions.trigger: When a hostile character moves within Range 5, even if that movement does not provoke Reactions.

core_system.passive_effect:
As a Protocol, the X-1 may change into one of the following modes. It may choose to start a scene in any form. You may not transform and use Full Afterburners on the same turn.

Mobile Suit mode:
  • Treats all Ranged weapons that deal energy as CQB weapons with Threat 3, but their range is halved (down to a minimum of their Threat). 
  • While in the Danger Zone, you may Hover.
  • 1/round, as a Quick Action, you may gain 4 Heat and choose an adjacent allied mech character. The target’s next attack gains the Reactor Bleed trait and counts as having consumed Lock On, but you may not make attacks or Stabilize until the target has resolved their attack, nor before taking this Quick Action.
Mobile Armor mode:
  • May count all movement as Flying.
  • The X-1 gains a special Hard Cover against Smart and Tech Attacks, and hostiles attempting to Lock On against the X-1 must first pass a Systems save. On a Failure, the Lock On action automatically fails.
  • Full Afterburners: 1/round, you may Boost as a Free Action. If you are not in the Danger Zone when you do so, you gain 2 heat.
  • You may not make melee attacks other than Ram.

passive_actions.name: Change Mode
passive_actions.detail: The X-1 may switch to a mode it is not already in. You may not transform and use Full Afterburners on the same turn.

passive_actions.name: Full Afterburners
passive_actions.detail: 1/round, you may Boost as a Free Action. If you are not in the Danger Zone when you do so, you gain 2 heat.

traits.name: Big Game Hunter
traits.description: The Vensa counts as Size 3 whenever inflicting Knockback or Prone with ranged attacks.

traits.name: Pint-Sized Terror
traits.description: 1/round, when attacking a Prone target larger than itself, the Vensa may deal +1d6 bonus damage.

traits.name: Open-Air Cockpit
traits.description: 1/round, you may Dismount or Mount the Vensa as a Free Action. This is the only way to leave the Vensa—you may not Eject because it has no ejection mechanism.

traits.name: Civilian Machine
traits.description: The Vensa makes all Checks and Saves at +1 Difficulty.

core_system.name: Custom Mounting
core_system.active_name: God’s Smallest, Most Vicious, Most Heartless Creature
core_system.active_effect: For the rest of the scene, the weapon mounted to your Heavy Mount (including Superheavy weapons) gains +1 Accuracy. The next critical hit you make with this weapon this scene has its damage maximized, including bonus damage. Upon activation of this core, if the weapon mounted to your Heavy Mount is destroyed, repair it automatically. If it has less than full Limited Charges, return it to full. If it is unloaded, reload it.
core_system.passive_effect:
The Heavy mount on this frame has been tweaked to perfection. Any weapon mounted to it (including Superheavy weapons) gains the following benefits:
  • When Barraging, you may fire this weapon twice instead of firing this weapon and another. This effect does not apply to Superheavy weapons.
  • On Crit: the target must succeed a Hull Save or else be knocked Prone.
  • Gain Tags: Knockback 3, AP, Overkill
Whenever the Vensa takes System Trauma, no matter the roll, the Heavy Mount is selected for destruction.

traits.name: Reinforced Suspension
traits.description: The Faze has immunity to fall damage. When the Faze jumps, it may jump up to its Speed horizontally or vertically (in any combination).

traits.name: Jump Jets
traits.description: When the Faze Boosts, it may jump. The Faze may jump even while midair.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The Faze makes all Agility Checks and Saves at +1 Accuracy.

core_system.name: Core Boosters
core_system.active_effect: As a Protocol, prime your jump jets. The next time you jump this turn, you may jump up to twice your Speed horizontally or vertically (or any combination of the two). At any point during this jump, you may choose to immediately fall down to the ground instead of obeying normal falling rules. Characters adjacent to your landing spot must succeed at an Agility Save or else take an amount of damage equal to the amount of spaces you have fallen, up to a maximum of 9 AP Kinetic, and fall Prone. On a successful save, they take half damage and do not fall Prone.

traits.name: Redline
traits.description: When the Zudah is in the Danger Zone, all of its voluntary movements ignore Engagement, Reactions, and the Ordnance Tag (i.e., it is allowed to use weapons with the Ordnance tag even after moving).

traits.name: 1000 Meters
traits.description: 1/round, whenever the Zudah voluntarily moves out of Engagement with another character, it may force the character to roll a contested Agility Check. If the target of this effect loses, then they become Prone until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Overtaxed Reactor
traits.description: The Zudah takes +1 Difficulty on all Engineering Checks and Saves.

core_system.name: Saturn Engine
core_system.active_effect: As a protocol, turn off the safety limiters on your thrusters. Divine Speed no longer has a maximum amount of d6 you may roll. Whenever you take a boost modified by Divine Speed, you project a Cone 3 pattern opposite of your direction of flight. Characters within this cone must pass an Agility Save or else take an amount of Burn equal to the heat cost of Divine Speed, up to a maximum of 9 Burn.
core_system.passive_effect: As a protocol, you may spin up your thrusters.

passive_actions.name: Spin Up Thrusters
passive_actions.detail: Roll a number of d6 with a maximum of 3d6—the result of this roll is how many additional spaces you may move during your next Boost action this round. However, you take an amount of Heat equivalent to half the result before resistances. All movement taken during this Boost action can be made as if you were flying, but you must end this movement on the ground or else start falling.

traits.name: Walking Coffin
traits.description: The Bleed is little more than a powered exoskeleton. As a result, it takes the stats of your pilot for Armor, Evasion, E-Defense, Speed, and Bonus HP. While in the Bleed, you may still use abilities and effects associated with Pilot Gear, Armor, and Weaponry.

traits.name: Up Close and Personal
traits.description: The Bleed ignores Armor and Resistances of characters it is Grappling or Jockeying.

traits.name: Tertiary Arm
traits.description: 1/round, the Bleed may use one piece of Pilot Gear or Pilot Weaponry as a Free Action. Additionally, the Bleed can interact with Pilot-scale objects as if it had Manipulators equipped.

core_system.name: Scrapper Kit
core_system.active_effect: Fly up to your Speed directly toward a hostile character of your choice. If you end this movement next to them, they are automatically Jockeyed, and you may take one Jockey option. This core is Efficient, and is refunded at the end of any Scene in which it is used.
core_system.passive_name: To the Wild Beasts of the Earth
core_system.passive_effect:
The Bleed may take the Jockey Action against characters larger than itself, rolling a Contested Hull Check instead of Grit. When it does so, it uses a modified table of standard Jockey effects that it may choose from as usual.
  • OVERLOAD SENSORS: The mech is IMPAIRED and SLOWED, and it can not draw Line of Sight beyond adjacent spaces until the end of its next turn.
  • SLICE REACTOR: Deal 2 Heat to the mech. If this action causes the mech to enter the Danger Zone, they take an additional 1d6 Heat.
  • SCRAP CHASSIS: Deal 4 Kinetic Damage. If this action causes the mech to drop below half health, they are Shredded until the end of their next turn.

name: RTX-440 Ground Assault Guntank
description:
The RTX-440 is a modern refit of the original RTX-44 Prototype Guntank that was developed as a conceptual testbed for a new form of 'heavy main battle tank', which would go on to be further developed into the RTX-65 and RX-75 Guntank line. This refit includes a 'partial' transformation system that allows the machine to assume a raised posture form similar to the RX-75, granting it a better vantage point along with allowing a wider traverse of its main hull. What makes it more distinct from its development counterparts however is the ability to assume an 'Assault Gun Mode' that brings its stance back to its original form factor, allowing for the Ground Assault Guntank to cross terrain at much higher speeds than other Guntanks due to its reduced frontal cross section.
As the role of heavy artillery has already been covered by the RX-75 and its successors, the RTX-440 has instead been tuned for high-speed assaults, smashing apart enemy formations and fortifications and exploiting these breaches before a response can be properly mounted. The first time this was put to the test was during the Battle of Ardennes, where the Ground Assault Guntank was used as a vanguard unit in the counterattack mounted by European forces against Zeon. It would gain particular renown during skimishes in the Fulda Gap where it dueled against Hildolfr units, and during the Ukrainian liberation campaign where Assault Guntank squadrons rolling across the steppes were particularly effective at out-maneuvering Zeon mobile weapon forces.
Originally intended as a stopgap using mothballed units, the RTX-440's successes has led to a new lease on life. Dedicated factory lines for the machine are contracted out to Nexter and Krauss-Maffei Wegmann as per agreement by the Earth Federation with KNDS, along with additional factories by Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa and Shanghai Steel.

traits.name: Treaded Vehicle
traits.description: Whenever the Assault Guntank makes a voluntary move, it must be made in a straight line. In order to change direction of movement, a new move must be initiated.

traits.name: Suicide Blitz
traits.description: Whenever the Assault Guntank moves through an object, wall, free-standing object, or any other piece of terrain, it first deals an amount of Kinetic damage to it based on the Assault Guntank’s size (Size 1: 10 AP, Size 2: 20 AP, Size 3: 30 AP). If this is enough to destroy the object, the Assault Guntank may pass through it. Otherwise, it is stopped as usual. Talents, Traits, and Systems that grant a similar effect contribute to this Trait additively.

traits.name: Close-in Targeting Solutions
traits.description: The Assault Guntank treats all Cannon weapons as if they were also CQB weapons with Threat 3.

core_system.name: Vernier Jet Thrusters
core_system.active_effect: For the rest of the scene, you may activate the Beyond the Line ability even when you have already used it previously in a round. Whenever you use this ability beyond the 1/round limit, you take 2 Heat. Gain access to the Stay Blue Full Action.

active_actions.name: Stay Blue
active_actions.detail: 1/scene. Move up to twice your speed in a direction of your choice, attacking with every weapon mounted to your suit at any point in the movement if you wish to do so. All weapons fired this way are unloaded as if they had the Loading tag. There is no effect anywhere that can modify, alter, stop, or otherwise impede this movement once it starts. Characters you collide with, regardless of their size, are knocked Prone and pushed to the outer edge of your movement, and terrain obstructions are utterly annihilated. Due to the stress this action puts on your frame, this is the only action you can take during any turn you use it.

core_system.passive_effect: 1/round, at any point during a movement you make, voluntary or otherwise, you may move up to 3 spaces. This movement may pass through other Characters and does not trigger Engagement or Reactions. All Characters you pass through with this movement take 3 Kinetic Damage. This is the only form of voluntary movement the Assault Guntank may take that does not have to be in a straight line.

traits.name: Captain of the Guard
traits.description: Whenever the Gyan Krieger moves, it may designate an adjacent allied character. This character may move with the Gyan Krieger, mirroring its movements for as long as they remain adjacent, and ignoring engagement and reactions from other characters.

traits.name: Old Hero
traits.description: 1/scene, the Gyan Krieger may turn a miss into a hit, a hit into a critical hit, or a critical hit into a natural 20.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.description: Adjacent allied characters may use the Gyan Krieger as Hard Cover.

traits.name: Ponderous
traits.description: The Gyan Krieger takes +1 Difficulty to all Agility Checks and Saves.

core_system.name: Battlefield Awareness Module
core_system.active_effect:
The Gyan Krieger plants its feet into the ground and widens its stance. It’s here where you will hold your ground or make your final stand. Until the end of the scene or you disable this effect as a Protocol, you gain the following effects:
  • You are Immobilized and have immunity to all forms of involuntary movement and Prone.
  • You have Resistance to all Damage, Heat, and Burn that originates from beyond Range 3.
  • Whenever you take the Overwatch reaction, you may choose to Barrage with a Superheavy weapon.
  • You may take the Overwatch reaction whenever an enemy enters, exits, or moves within threat.

name: PTX-140 Hardballer
description:
One of the first machines designed by NEVEC from the ground up for combating Mobile Suits, the PTX-140 Hardballer is an agile machine built for aggressive hit-and-run tactics. It accomplishes this through its integrated flight backpack that allows it to either leap and hover for respectable distances or skate across the ground at high speeds. Along with being able to mount a versatile array of weapons, the Hardballer also includes a close combat weapon specifically designed for it that is commonly described as an oversized chainsaw.
Being smaller than most Mobile Suits yet larger than a majority of Junior Mobile Suits, NEVEC has coined the term 'Vital Suit' to describe this new size class of mobile weapon.

traits.name: Thruster Skating
traits.description: 1/round, after you Boost, the Hardballer may move additional spaces up to the pilot's Grit that ignores engagement. The boost also forces enemy reactions against it to take +1 Difficulty.

traits.name: Integrated Flight Systems
traits.description: When Boosting, the Hardballer may opt to Hover. Whenever the Hardballer ends its turn not on the ground or any solid surface, it gains 2 Heat.

core_system.name: Integrated Motorized Close Combat Weaponry
core_system.active_effect: The VS Saw immediately deploys and revs up. Gain 5 Charges. Until the end of the scene or until all charges are expended, a charge may be expended as a free action to use the VS Saw. Additionally, on hit any number of charges may be used to add 1D6 bonus damage per charge.
core_system.description: Mounted in a wrist module on one of its arms, the Hardballer possesses a close combat weapon in the form of a motorized chain blade. This weapon, once extended and revved up, can tear apart armor and internal components of other mobile suits.
core_system.passive_effect: When in Danger Zone, the VS Saw integrated weapon inflicts Shred on-hit. This effect lasts until the start of the Hardballer's next turn.

name: RGM-79LX GM Pebble
description: The GM Pebble is built around, but more significantly into, the Light Armor type. Designed as an early proof of concept for the flexibility of movable frame technology, it managed to impress at tech shows due to its human-like grenade-throwing motions. Creating enough excitement among the brass, test units see supported field use despite the tension its weapon of choice creates within colonies. This fact, combined with 16Lab and Neucom’s large part in its development, has led to ZOE-2 Units calling the frame their “Evil Step-Sister”.

traits.name: IMBALANCING CONTACT
traits.description: 1/Round When targeting an enemy’s space while throwing a grenade, you may immediately make a ranged attack roll on that enemy before the grenade’s effects occur. On hit, that enemy takes 1 kinetic damage and +2 Difficulty to Agility Saves until the end of this turn.

traits.name: OPTIMIZED THROW
traits.description: When you make an attack on a mount that contains an Aux weapon during a Barrage or Skirmish, you may throw a grenade instead of using the Aux weapon.

core_system.name: ASYMMETRICAL BODY
core_system.active_effect:
As a protocol, for the rest of the turn, your grenades gain +15 Range. Gain +1 charges to up to 2 different limited grenade systems of your choice.
This ability is Efficient and will refund 1 Core Point at the end of any scene in which this ability was used.
core_system.description: "No, that's not all; there lies the biggest egg still. How long will it take? I'm really almost sick of it."

traits.name: Bearer of the Curse
traits.description: You are always a valid target for your own invasions. When you target yourself with an Invasion, you may automatically take the effect as if you targeted an ally, but you still take 2 Heat, which counts as an external source of heat for the purposes of Traits.

traits.name: Flowers Bloom at Dawn
traits.description: When you are adjacent to an allied character, you gain Resistance to all external sources of Heat damage.

core_system.name: Mirror-Lake Radome
core_system.active_effect: For the rest of the scene or until you disable this effect as a Protocol, project a Burst 3 area around you. All characters fully in this area, except you, are Intangible. For as long as this effect is activated, you may affect both tangible and intangible characters. Whenever an ally starts their turn in this area, their next melee or ranged attack that turn deals +1d6 bonus damage on a hit. While this effect is active, you are Slowed. This effect ends immediately if you are Stunned or Jammed.

traits.name: Vile Repast
traits.description: Whenever you clear a condition that was not self-inflicted, you may either recover 2 HP, or clear 1 Heat.

traits.name: Underdog
traits.description: For every condition you have that was not self-inflicted, you gain +1 Tech Attack until it is cleared.

core_system.name: Psycommu-Assisted Sensors Array
core_system.active_effect: Become Shredded until the end of the scene. The effects of your traits and core passive are all doubled whenever they trigger. Gain access to the Consume the Twilight Full Tech Action.

active_actions.name: Consume the Twilight
active_actions.detail:
Choose a Blast 2 area within Range 50 and line of sight. For the rest of the scene, or until you change the area of effect with another Full Tech action, this area becomes a complete dead zone. Characters at least partially in this area are unable to draw line of sight beyond adjacent spaces, are unable to select any character but you for any effect, and are unable to communicate with anyone, inside or out of the zone. Characters within the dead zone always consider you to be a valid target for actions, even when they wouldn’t normally be able to hit you (out of range, out of sensors, etc). Similarly, any space or character within the area of effect always counts as being within sensors and line of sight for the purposes of tech actions for you.
If a character attempts to leave this zone, you may interrupt their movement and Invade them as a reaction. If you critically hit them as part of this reaction, they are teleported back to the center of the zone, or as close as possible, and Immobilized until the end of the turn. This can happen as many times per round as it is triggered, obeying normal reaction limits.

core_system.passive_effect: You are able to critically hit with your Tech Attacks. Whenever you critically hit with your tech attacks, you deal +1 bonus Heat damage. The amount of bonus damage you deal on a critical hit scales with how many Structure and Stress points you are below maximum. For example, if you are at 3 Structure and 2 Stress, every time you critically hit with a Tech Attack, you deal +4 bonus Heat damage in total.

traits.name: Whirlwind
traits.description: 1/round, before making any non-weapon melee attack, the Efreet may attack the same target with a single Aux weapon of its choice. This attack can not benefit from bonus damage.

traits.name: Last Rites
traits.description: The Efreet treats all Aux melee weapons as if they were also Heavy melee weapons for the purposes of traits, systems, and talents.

core_system.name: "Rose" Combat Computer
core_system.active_effect: Gain a Combo die, a d6, starting at 1. Whenever you critically hit with an aux weapon or any non-weapon melee attack, the Combo die ticks up by one, to a maximum of 6. At 6, you may perform one of three finisher moves, which you may activate as a Free Action when taking certain actions. When you take one of these actions, the Combo die is reset to 1.

active_actions.name: Eviscerate
active_actions.detail: This action may be taken whenever you attack with an Improvised attack. You plunge your arm into your enemy and violently tear away at internal systems. If your Improvised Attack reduces the target’s HP to 0, instead of rolling the Structure damage table as usual, you may instead force them to roll the Stress damage table before taking Structure damage as usual. Either way, you reduce their rolled result by one category, down to a minimum of Direct Hit/Meltdown. If this attack does not reduce the target’s HP to 0, you may force them to roll either the Structure or Stress damage tables and suffer resulting effects without dealing Structure or Stress.

active_actions.name: Suplex
active_actions.detail: This action may be taken after a successful grapple. Make a melee attack on the Grapple target. On a hit, deal 1d6+4 Kinetic damage, knock them Prone, and move them to any other free space adjacent to you.

active_actions.name: Giant Swing
active_actions.detail: This action may be taken after a successful Ram. Make a melee attack on the Ram target, moving as necessary to become adjacent. On a hit, you spin them around by the legs before sending them flying. The target becomes Impaired until the end of your next turn. You may throw them at a space within Range 5. If this would cause them to collide with another character or obstruction, they both take 1d6 Kinetic damage before landing in a free adjacent space of your choice. Otherwise, just the thrown character takes damage.

traits.name: AQUATIC
traits.description: The Zock treats all bodies of water or similar fluids as normal terrain, and has integrated EVA for deep ocean environments.

traits.name: ULTRA-LARGE THERMONUCLEAR REACTOR
traits.description: The Zock has resistance to heat as long as it's not self-inflicted.

traits.name: COLOSSUS
traits.description: The Zock can be used for hard cover by adjacent allied characters.

traits.name: SLOW
traits.description: The Zock receives +1 difficulty on Agility checks and saves.

core_system.name: Mobile Fortress
core_system.active_effect:
When activated, you start redirecting all possible energy to the Zock’s Phonon Maser Gun, an incredibly powerful Mega Particle cannon battery that requires high amounts of power. You become Jammed until the weapon is fired.
This weapon can be fired even while Jammed. This weapon also affects every adjacent space to its range line once fired, it deals damage equal to 3d6 +  the Zock’s current heat. At the start of your turn you can charge this weapon as a free action, every time the Zock charges the weapon it can add the heat value from the characters currently on board to the final damage of the weapon. Once the weapon is discharged all characters whose heat value was used clear all heat.

active_actions.name: Charge the Phonon Maser
active_actions.detail: You can add the heat value from a character currently on board to the final damage of the Phonon Maser Gun.

core_system.passive_effect: Up to four size 1 or lower, adjacent non-Immobilized characters can board the Zock as a quick action. While on board, they occupy the same space as you and are immobilized though they move when you move, while on board they cannot be targeted, target others, or be affected by outside effects.

name: MS-06E-3 Zaku Flipper
description:
When Dr.Minovsky successfully defected to the Federation, it was said that Gihern broke his usually calm, calculating demeanor and had a very wrathful outburst. In the opening weeks of the war, the United Maintenance plan went into full effect. While it was never stated out loud, it was an open secret that Dr.Minovsky would rapidly speed up the Earth Federation’s development of mobile suits within months. As such, most experimental projects, including the Psycomu projects, were placed on the back burner for a reliable core fleet of mobile suits. One such frame was the MS-06E Zaku Reconnaissance Type, for it was stripped of the MS-06c’s triple-layer composite armor and given advanced camera systems for scouting the enemy. After the battle of Loum, the MS-06E was one of many Mobile Suits that would receive an upgrade package. In their case, most became the vastly superior MS-06E-3 Zaku Flipper.

Named after its highly advanced flipper backpack fins that would flip and flap when acquiring and tracking objects. The auto safety limiters were also removed to improve the Mobile Suit's maneuverability; This design choice was inspired by the Red Comet's maneuverability at Loum. Meanwhile, its cameras, Sensory equipment, & radar were dramatically enhanced so that the Mobile Suit’s speed wouldn’t affect its Reconnaissance abilities. At the end of the war, the Earth Federation attempted to dissolve the Zeonic Company to requisition many of the Zaku Flippers into their Mobile Forces. This was due to being unable to successfully develop a reconnaissance Mobile Suit that could rival the Zaku Flippers specs. However, Garma was able to negotiate a deal where the Federation would get a portion of these Mobile Suits. In exchange, Zeonic was allowed to stay as an independent manufacturer, but would assist Anaheim Electronics in future Mobile Suit Development to be used by the Federation for a very long time.

traits.name: Manipulated Data
traits.description: 1/round if 2 characters in your sensor range and Line of Sight have the same condition - gain a free action to apply that condition to an unaffected character in sensors and Line of Sight. This condition lasts until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Miniaturized Buzznorse Booster
traits.description: During its turn, the Zaku Flipper is Invisible; it reappears at the end of the turn.

traits.name: Unrestrained S-Type Vernier Thruster Array
traits.description: 1/round, before or after the Zaku Flipper's Move, or Boost, it may move 3 spaces in any direction. This movement ignores engagement and doesn't provoke reactions.

traits.name: Full Manual Control Systems
traits.description: The Zaku Flipper takes +1 Difficulty to all Engineering saves and checks.

core_system.name: Directional Laser and Sonic Sensors Backpack
core_system.active_effect:
The following effects happen till the end of the scene:
  • Within sensors, you and your Allies' Attacks/Tech Attacks made above the enemy’s Evasion/E-Defense are considered critical hits. This only activates effects requiring it, and you don’t benefit from critical damage output. (not nat 20!)
  • Enemies can’t have the Invisible or Hidden condition within the Zaku Flipper’s Sensors. Essentially, making all enemy positions publicly known.
