  • Upon activation, or when the Zaku Flipper’s turn starts, all enemies within sensors get Lock-On & Scan automatically. Lock-On applied this way can only be removed when enemies start their turn out of the Zaku Flipper’s sensors.
core_system.passive_effect: When applying lock-on and/or scan, you may ignore line-of-sight restrictions so long as the target is within your sensor range.

name: MS-06L Zaku II Sniper Type
description:
When Gihern immediately greenlit the United Maintenance plan at the start of the war, it led them to revamp many Mobile Suit variations to fit multiple roles, allowing for mass production with ease. One such M.S. was the MS-06E Zaku Recon type, which would serve as the template for the Zaku Flipper Recon Type series. As the War continued on Earth, it became apparent that the Magella Top Guns needed to be replaced with a more precise and powerful rifle. As a result, the Gelgoog project was in full swing, but its already developed beam weapons required testing. Kycillia’s Noisy Fairy Squadron mechanics worked with California Base, using a spare MS-06E Zaku Recon type, and crudely integrated one of the Gelgoog’s Experimental Beam Cannon. This created an effective sniper capable of providing support with a low size profile. However, its Beam Cannon used too much power, resulting in nearly shutting down the mobile suit completely. Thus, an additional M.H.D. Sub Generator Backpack was integrated. They modified the prototype Beam Canon into a more power-efficient and customizable RA-2 Heavy Beam Rifle. 
It was quickly manufactured shortly after the disappearance of Garma Zabi, and the war began shifting into the Federation’s favor. Unfortunately, they were produced too late to join the battle at Jaburo, but they would prove themselves a lethal threat. As Zeonic Forces retreated from planet Earth, many Zaku II Sniper Types were deployed on all fronts. A majority used guerrilla tactics to cripple and exploit the Earth Federation’s lightly guarded, rapidly expanding supply lines to their horror. In North America, these Mobile Suits slowed the Earth Federation’s rapid advance into a cautious crawl akin to World War 1 verdun. It allowed Zeonic Personnel with their Prototypes and research to escape back into space. Since the end of the One Year War, however, unlike the Zaku Flippers that got requisitioned, a number of the MS-06L Zaku II Snipers were decommissioned as part of the peace treaty. Some say this was due to them killing several incompetent Earth Federation officers who were extremely well-connected to the Earth Federation government. Regardless, they’ve become the favorite weapon of private defense contractors operating from deep space to ground operations.

DUE TO LIMITATIONS WITH COMP/CON, IT has an Heavy Mount for its integrated Weapon that accepts mods! (RA-2 Heavy Beam Rifle)

traits.name: Foldable Knee Pad
traits.description: 1/round when consuming a target’s Lock-On, roll with an additional accuracy.

traits.name: Triple Multipurpose Camera Module
traits.description: When the Zaku II Sniper Scans a target, you learn all three listed types of information about it. You always know the target's current HP & Heat until you take the Scan action again.

traits.name: X-ACTO Knife Precision
traits.description: When the Zaku II Sniper causes Systems Trauma to another character, the Zaku II Sniper's pilot chooses which system or weapon is destroyed. No roll is made to determine what is destroyed.

core_system.name: M.H.D. B-type Sub Generator Backpack
core_system.active_effect:
As a quick action, transfer your frame’s accumulated heat into the next weapon attack in one of two forms. Should it hit, the following effect happens:

  • Burn: The target receives a special burn marker, which stacks on top of any existing burn applied to the target. Due to Minnovsky Particles being the source of burn, all rolls to end burn are made with 2 additional difficulties. 


  • Heat: If an enemy Overheats due to this effect, your enemy doesn’t roll reactor stress. Instead, they automatically take the lowest outcome possible.  

It’s considered efficient and restores the core power once the current scene ends.
core_system.passive_effect:
You may attach energy-damaging weapons to the backpack. This grants weapons equipped to it with the following tags: 
  • AP 

  • Self Heat 1(Aux), 2(Main)


    You also gain access to a modifiable integrated weapon, but due to Comp/Con Limitations it must be equipped manually into the Heavy Mount provided! Meaning you must be LL2 in the Zaku Flipper to access this weapon and the frame it's for simultaneously.

name: RX-77D GunCannon Mass Production Type
description: DUE TO LIMITATIONS WITH COMP/CON, IT has an extra Flex and Heavy Mount for its integrated Weapons that accepts mods! (240mm Shoulder Cannons or 24 Missile Shoulder Launchers)

traits.name: Advanced Cooling Systems
traits.description: When you stabilize the RX-77D to clear heat, or you exceed the frame’s Heat Cap, it also gains soft cover until the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Mobile Firing Platform
traits.description: Choose one RX-77D mount: All Launchers or Cannons equipped on that mount gain Arcing.

traits.name: Autonomous Targeting Systems
traits.description: The RX-77D can use ranged weapons to attack a character with the Lock On condition as if its weapon had Seeking, but must consume the Lock On during the attack. When it does so, the attack’s damage cannot be reduced in any way.

traits.name: Slow Reflexes
traits.description: The RX-77D has difficulty to all agility saves and checks.

core_system.name: Interchangeable Artillery Support Backpack
core_system.active_effect:
Upon activation, you can Skirmish or Overwatch once with a Superheavy Weapon for the round; it still costs the appropriate action as normal and deals half damage, burn, and heat.

It is considered efficient, and you regain the Core power in the next scene
core_system.passive_effect: Whenever firing upon anything that counts as cover, you may choose to have your attack deal half damage. However, all cover is ignored for ½ mechs, Infantry, and Drones using it.

name: RGC-83 GM Cannon II
description: DUE TO LIMITATIONS WITH COMP/CON, IT has an extra Flex and Heavy Mount for its integrated Weapon that accepts mods! (Dual Beam Cannons)

traits.name: Integrated Chobam Armor
traits.description: The RGC-83 GM Cannon II has resistance to Explosive sources of damage.

traits.name: Auto-Adjusting Fire Support
traits.description: 1/round when the RGC-83 GM Cannon II makes a ranged attack on its turn, it can target any character within Range 3 of an allied character that is at least partially in the RGC-83 GM Cannon II's Sensors, measuring Line of Sight and Range from that allied character.

traits.name: Wide Stance
traits.description:
Dismounted characters, frames size ½ - size X (X being the frame’s size) that are adjacent to the RGC-83 GM Cannon II may always treat it as Hard Cover.

However, your frame must be in the cover of something greater than your current frame size to be considered in Hard Cover!

traits.name: Armory Encumbrance
traits.description:
When the RGC-83 GM Cannon II makes its standard move or Boosts, it can only move in straight lines.

You also suffer difficulty with all agility checks and saves.

core_system.name: Embedded Energy Cap Circuitry
core_system.active_effect:
Your Integrated Weapon loses the Ordnance Tag for the rest of the combat scene. It is fired with the rest of your weapons as a barrage attack. This can also be fired independently as a skirmish attack. It does 4D6+4, and you take self-heat 4 when firing.

The RGC-83 GM Cannon II also ignores the trait Armory Encumbrance for the rest of the scene. This is due to the Energy Cap no longer feeding upon your frame’s reactor.
core_system.passive_name: The Culmination of M.S. Artillery Support
core_system.passive_effect: 1/round The RGC-83 GM Cannon II can choose to ignore dealing damage to any allies caught in a Line, blast, or cone-shaped attack, so long as an enemy with lock-on is included in that attack.

name: RGM-79 Light-Type GunCannon
description:
The EFF MS development plan was changed due to the theft of the RX-78-02 Gundam and the Pegasus-class, which forced the Federation to base their further development on the RX-77-02 Guncannon and use available operational data from the previously built test units, especially the Gundam. The result was a mobile suit that combined the mobility and close combat capabilities of the Gundam, while retaining the firepower and durability of the Guncannon.
The Light Cannon sported a relatively balanced performance, capable of engaging in both close combat and mid-range combat. The Light Cannon has modified arms and legs, while the chest, head, and main armament come from the Guncannon. The backpack sported a beam saber on the left side and a beam cannon on the right side. Like its predecessors, the Light Cannon also retains the Core Block System, which can act as an escape craft system, ensuring its pilot's survival.
DUE TO LIMITATIONS WITH COMP/CON, ITS SECOND HEAVY MOUNT IS FOR THE STORED HEAVY WEAPON ONLY

traits.name: Vessel of the White Devil
traits.description: Any number of times per round, whenever an enemy's ranged or melee attack roll is equal to the RGM-79 Light-Type's Evasion, you may force that attack to miss as a reaction automatically. The RGM-79 Light-Type has Immunity to all damage and effects from attacks that miss this way, and they cannot be rerolled.

traits.name: Versatile Modifications
traits.description: When you apply a Mod to a weapon on the RMG-79 Light Type, its effects apply to all valid weapons on the same type of Mount. You may apply only one Mod per Mount. All mods with Limited lose that tag and instead gain Recharge (4+)

traits.name: Unworthy Vessel
traits.description: This frame gains +1 difficulty to Engineering checks & saves, and cannot use actions gained from overcharge to make tech actions.

core_system.name: Integrated Hardpoint Extender
core_system.active_effect: Until the end of the scene, 1/round, you may Quick Fire the stored weapon as a Skirmish or part of a Barrage. The stored weapon automatically reloads immediately after the attack is resolved. Additionally, all range-based weaponry on your frame does not suffer from engagement. This includes ignoring restrictions preventing ranged weapons from being fired within a certain range of you.
core_system.description:
The Light Cannon is equipped with various hardpoints, found on its shoulder pauldrons, elbows, and knees, which can be used to mount different types of equipment, including weapons and shields. 
Backpack-Integrated sub-arms allow for quick-swapping of armaments on the Light-Type.
core_system.passive_effect:
You gain Extenders for your Heavy Mount, which can be used to store one other Heavy or smaller weapon. Weapons stored in this way are not equipped to your mech's mounts and may not be used to attack.
You also gain the Quick Swap protocol

passive_actions.name: Quick Swap
passive_actions.detail: 1/round, you may swap the equipped weapon with the one stored on the Extender. The recently stored weapon automatically reloads at the end of this turn.
